source_claims.statement: Variant analysis after cPanel CVE. Cron injection required auth and delayed. AI Scanner XSS blocked by missing scan_id. Pivot to forgotten debug endpoints that leaked scan_ids. Composed XSS → admin creation → cron RCE.

research_questions.formulation: After an authenticated primitive and an unauthenticated XSS both appear blocked, does a forgotten debug endpoint supply the missing prerequisite for composition?

layer_b_candidate_principles: When two promising primitives are each blocked by a missing prerequisite, examine routing and debug surfaces for the missing link
Variant analysis of similar products can surface analogous but differently protected features
